name: GlStateDispatcher
description: Dispatcher calling functors<GlStateFunctor> based on received argument type(s).

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g.

methods.name: dispFunctor
methods.description: Return functor that would be dispatched for given argument(s); None if no dispatch; ambiguous dispatch throws.

methods.name: dispMatrix
methods.description: Return dictionary with contents of the dispatch matrix.
